sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at the
sentences.zh: 我负责报道《纽约时报》每日简报

sentences.en: New York Times.
sentences.zh: 《DealBook》的商业与政策新闻。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市DealBook峰会的现场，采访商业、政治和文化领域

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine
sentences.zh: 一些最具影响力的领袖，包括万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·

sentences.en: Lagarde, Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以直接观看其中一些毫无防备、未经过滤的真实对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at nytimes.com on November
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在 nytimes.com 上对精选采访进行现场直播，供任何人免费

sentences.en: 18th.
sentences.zh: 观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并免费阅读我们所有的资讯一个月。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望大家准时收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: Across the world, there are rising concerns of a potential coronavirus pandemic after a major jump in cases outside of China.
sentences.zh: 在中国境外病例大幅激增之后，全球范围内对潜在冠状病毒大流行的担忧正在加剧。

sentences.en: From the New York Times,
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: 30 countries and territories, nearly 80,000 cases.
sentences.zh: 30个国家和地区，近8万个病例。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 就在今天。

sentences.en: South Korea, which is now 750 cases or more.
sentences.zh: 韩国的病例现在已经达到或超过750例。

sentences.en: And in Iran, where there have been close to 100 cases, and the death toll is 15.
sentences.zh: 而在伊朗，病例已接近100例，死亡人数达到15人。

sentences.en: What began as a public health crisis in China is well on its way to becoming a pandemic.
sentences.zh: 这场始于中国公共卫生危机的事件，正在演变成一场全球大流行。

sentences.en: It's still unclear how the virus made it into Italy.
sentences.zh: 目前尚不清楚该病毒是如何进入意大利的。

sentences.en: Four new cases are here on French territory.
sentences.zh: 法国领土上新增了四起病例。

sentences.en: Japan.
sentences.zh: 日本。

sentences.en: Canada.
sentences.zh: 加拿大。

sentences.en: Afghanistan.
sentences.zh: 阿富汗。

sentences.en: With Austria, Switzerland, and Croatia all confirming their first cases.
sentences.zh: 奥地利、瑞士和克罗地亚都确认了首例病例。

sentences.en: Now.
sentences.zh: 现在。

sentences.en: The CDC in the last hour warning Americans to prepare for the possibility of an outbreak.
sentences.zh: 美国疾控中心在过去一小时内警告美国人做好应对疫情爆发的准备。

sentences.en: As officials warn of a coming outbreak in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 正值官员们警告美国即将爆发疫情之际。

sentences.en: CDC's Dr. Nancy Messonnier said, it's not a question of if the novel coronavirus will spread through the United States, but when.
sentences.zh: 疾控中心的南希·梅森尼尔博士表示，新型冠状病毒是否会在美国传播已不再是“会不会”的问题，而是“什么时候”的问题。

sentences.en: My colleague Donald G.
sentences.zh: 我的同事唐纳德·G·

sentences.en: McNeil Jr.
sentences.zh: 麦克尼尔，

sentences.en: on how bad the coronavirus might get.
sentences.zh: 将探讨冠状病毒可能会发展到多严重的地步。

sentences.en: Outbreak could go any direction.
sentences.zh: 疫情可能会向任何方向发展。

sentences.en: I do think that we are heading towards a pandemic.
sentences.zh: 我的确认为我们正在走向一场大流行。

sentences.en: It's Thursday, February 27th.
sentences.zh: 今天是2月27日，星期四。

sentences.en: Donald, I have the sense that you have covered a lot of epidemics in your career.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德，我感觉你在职业生涯中报道过很多流行病。

sentences.en: And if this isn't too strange a question, how many epidemics have you covered?
sentences.zh: 如果这个问题不太奇怪的话，你到底报道过多少次流行病？

sentences.en: SARS, MERS, bird flu, 2009 swine flu, Zika, dengue and chikungunya didn't really become epidemics.
sentences.zh: 非典、中东呼吸综合征、禽流感、2009年猪流感、寨卡病毒、登革热和基孔肯雅热其实并没有真正成为流行病。

sentences.en: And also I've covered HIV, although that started long before my time as a health reporter.
sentences.zh: 我还报道过艾滋病，尽管那开始于我作为健康记者的时代很久以前。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: And seasonal flu, have I forgotten anything?
sentences.zh: 还有季节性流感，我是不是漏掉了什么？

sentences.en: That's enough, right?
sentences.zh: 这已经够多了吧？

sentences.en: That seems like enough.
sentences.zh: 这似乎已经够多了。

sentences.en: That seems like a lot of epidemics.
sentences.zh: 这听起来像是经历了很多次流行病。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And this.
sentences.zh: 而这一次。

sentences.en: And by this you mean?
sentences.zh: 你说的这一次是指？

sentences.en: COVID-19, coronavirus infectious disease 2019.
sentences.zh: COVID-19，即2019冠状病毒病。

sentences.en: Well, that's the reason we want to talk to you, Donald, is because you have this history and this experience when it comes to epidemics.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这就是我们想和你聊聊的原因，唐纳德，因为你在应对流行病方面拥有这样的历史和经验。

sentences.en: And at this moment, there is a lot of news about this new virus, the coronavirus, but not a lot of understanding about it.
sentences.zh: 此时此刻，关于这种新病毒——冠状病毒有很多新闻，但人们对它的了解并不多。

sentences.en: So given your history, how do you rank this epidemic in terms of previous epidemics, in terms of, let me use some unscientific words here, bigness, scariness, awfulness?
sentences.zh: 鉴于你的经历，你如何将这次流行病与之前的流行病进行排名，用一些不够科学的词汇来说，比如严重程度、可怕程度、恐怖程度？

sentences.en: Because I spend a lot of time thinking about whether I'm being too alarmist or whether I'm being not alarmist enough.
sentences.zh: 因为我花了大量时间思考自己是不是表现得过于恐慌，还是说还不够恐慌。

sentences.en: And this is alarmist, but I think right now it's justified.
sentences.zh: 这确实令人恐慌，但我认为现在这种恐慌是合理的。

sentences.en: This one reminds me of what I have read about the 1918 Spanish influenza.
sentences.zh: 这次疫情让我想起了我读过的1918年西班牙流感。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: And the reason I say that is because right now, the only measure we have for the death rate from this flu is a study that the Chinese did of the first 45,000 cases.
sentences.zh: 我这么说的原因是，目前我们评估这种流感死亡率的唯一依据，是中国对前45,000个病例进行的一项研究。

sentences.en: And of those, 80% were mild, 20% were various degrees of seriousness, up to critical and on a respirator and an organ failure, and 2.3% died.
sentences.zh: 在这些病例中，80%是轻症，20%是不同程度的严重病情，直至危重、需要使用呼吸机和器官衰竭，其中2.3%的人死亡。

sentences.en: Now, 2.5% mortality is about the mortality rate of the 1918 flu.
sentences.zh: 2.5%的死亡率大约相当于1918年流感的死亡率。

sentences.en: Which was a very big deal.
sentences.zh: 那可是一件大事。

sentences.en: It was a very big deal epidemic.
sentences.zh: 这是一场非常重大的流行病。

sentences.en: Now, it's not the Black Death, and the Black Death, a third of the world died.
sentences.zh: 当然，它还不是黑死病，当年黑死病夺去了世界三分之一人口的生命。

sentences.en: But in 1918, not everybody died, but everybody knew somebody who died.
sentences.zh: 但在1918年，并非所有人都死了，但每个人都认识死于这场疫情的人。

sentences.en: I mean, my oldest friend's grandmother died.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我最好的朋友的祖母就去世了。

sentences.en: She was a young woman with two kids.
sentences.zh: 她是一个有着两个孩子的年轻女性。

sentences.en: She died.
sentences.zh: 她去世了。

sentences.en: Another guy I talked to said, oh, yeah, my grandmother's sister died in that one.
sentences.zh: 我交谈过的另一个人说，哦，是的，我祖母的姐姐就是死于那场流感。

sentences.en: I thought you were here to bring calm, Donald.
sentences.zh: 我还以为你是来平复情绪的，唐纳德。

sentences.en: I'm trying to bring a sense that if things don't change, a lot of us might die.
sentences.zh: 我只是想传达这样一种意识：如果情况不发生改变，我们中的很多人可能会死。

sentences.en: If you have 300 relatively close friends and acquaintances, six of them would die in a 2.5% mortality situation.
sentences.zh: 如果你有300个相对亲近的朋友和熟人，在死亡率为2.5%的情况下，其中六个人将会死去。

sentences.en: Okay, you're painting a pretty scary portrait here.
sentences.zh: 好吧，你这幅画卷描绘得真够吓人的。

sentences.en: What makes this virus something so lethal and fearsome?
sentences.zh: 究竟是什么让这种病毒如此致命和可怕？

sentences.en: What is it specifically about this virus?
sentences.zh: 这种病毒究竟有什么特殊之处？

sentences.en: There are six kinds of coronaviruses we know about before.
sentences.zh: 我们以前了解的冠状病毒有六种。

sentences.en: Two of them, SARS and MERS, kill a lot of people.
sentences.zh: 其中两种，非典和中东呼吸综合征，夺去了很多人的生命。

sentences.en: Those are both coronaviruses.
sentences.zh: 这两种都是冠状病毒。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: SARS kills about 10% of the people who get it.
sentences.zh: 非典大约会杀死10%的感染者。

sentences.en: SARS is gone.
sentences.zh: 非典已经消失了。

sentences.en: MERS kills about 30% of the people who get it.
sentences.zh: 中东呼吸综合征大约会杀死30%的感染者。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Those are high death rates.
sentences.zh: 这些死亡率真高。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: But there are four other coronaviruses that cause about a quarter of all the common colds in this year.
sentences.zh: 但还有其他四种冠状病毒，它们引发了今年大约四分之一的普通感冒。

sentences.en: And you've had all of them.
sentences.zh: 而你全都得过。

sentences.en: I've had all of them.
sentences.zh: 我全得过。

sentences.en: Everybody's had all of them.
sentences.zh: 每个人都全得过。

sentences.en: So we've had coronaviruses and just maybe not called them coronaviruses.
sentences.zh: 所以我们其实都得过冠状病毒，只是可能没叫它们冠状病毒罢了。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: You called them, I had a cold.
sentences.zh: 你会说，我感冒了。

sentences.en: There are many causes of the common cold, but some of the most popular ones are four different coronaviruses.
sentences.zh: 普通感冒有许多诱因，但最常见的一些是由四种不同的冠状病毒引起的。

sentences.en: This doesn't give you a common cold.
sentences.zh: 这种病毒引起的不是普通的感冒。

sentences.en: It attaches deep in your lungs.
sentences.zh: 它会附着在你的肺部深处。

sentences.en: So you don't get runny nose as much as you get fevers and cough.
sentences.zh: 所以比起流鼻涕，你更多的是发烧和咳嗽。

sentences.en: And then ultimately, if it keeps getting bad, you get pneumonia.
sentences.zh: 然后最终，如果病情持续恶化，你会患上肺炎。

sentences.en: And that's what kills a lot of people.
sentences.zh: 这就是夺去很多人生命的原因。

sentences.en: The final stage of this.
sentences.zh: 这是病情的最后阶段。

sentences.en: And it's a viral pneumonia.
sentences.zh: 而且这是病毒性肺炎。

sentences.en: So giving antibiotics does not help.
sentences.zh: 所以使用抗生素是没有用的。

sentences.en: So what you just said makes me think that in the grand scheme, this coronavirus is not as bad as a SARS or a MERS.
sentences.zh: 你刚才说的话让我觉得，从宏观角度来看，这种冠状病毒并没有非典或中东呼吸综合征那么严重。

sentences.en: So help me understand why, even though it's seemingly statistically not as bad as those, it is something quite worrisome.
sentences.zh: 所以请帮我理解，为什么尽管它从统计数据上看似乎没有那么严重，却依然让人相当担忧。

sentences.en: SARS and MERS, if you get them, are very likely to kill you.
sentences.zh: 非典和中东呼吸综合征一旦感染，极有可能致命。

sentences.en: But you're very unlikely to get them because they don't transmit very easily.
sentences.zh: 但你极难感染它们，因为它们的传播能力不强。

sentences.en: If you don't hang around camels or emergency rooms in Saudi Arabia, you're unlikely to get
sentences.zh: 如果你不去沙特阿拉伯接触骆驼或急诊室，你就不太可能感染

sentences.en: MERS.
sentences.zh: 中东呼吸综合征。

sentences.en: This coronavirus is very transmissible, not as transmissible as measles, about as transmissible as flu, maybe a little bit less.
sentences.zh: 这种冠状病毒的传播力非常强，虽不如麻疹那么强，但与流感差不多，或许稍微弱一点。

sentences.en: But it's quite transmissible.
sentences.zh: 但它的确具备相当强的传播力。

sentences.en: I mean, we saw that on the Diamond Princess.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们在“钻石公主”号上看到了这一点。

sentences.en: Here you had a boat with three or four people who might have had the virus on it.
sentences.zh: 当时那艘船上有三四个人可能携带了病毒。

sentences.en: And then suddenly there were, what was it, 600 people who had the virus on it.
sentences.zh: 然后突然之间，有多少人来着，600人感染了病毒。

sentences.en: That's a transmissible virus.
sentences.zh: 这是一种传播力极强的病毒。

sentences.en: And why is it so transmissible?
sentences.zh: 为什么它这么容易传播？

sentences.en: What is it about the virus?
sentences.zh: 这病毒究竟有什么特性？

sentences.en: Do we know?
sentences.zh: 我们知道吗？

sentences.en: We don't know.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道。

sentences.en: We know that it attaches to some receptors deep in the lung called the ACE2 receptors, but then so do other viruses.
sentences.zh: 我们知道它会附着在肺部深处的一些被称为ACE2受体的受体上，但其他病毒也是如此。

sentences.en: We don't know why this one jumps easily.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道为什么这种病毒能轻易传播。

sentences.en: Something in the genome does it, but we haven't pinpointed that genetic change yet.
sentences.zh: 基因组中的某些东西导致了这一点，但我们尚未准确定位这种基因变化。

sentences.en: So we don't know why it's so transmissible, but we do know that it's passing from person to person quickly.
sentences.zh: 所以我们不知道它为什么这么容易传播，但我们确实知道它正在人与人之间快速传播。

sentences.en: So how exactly do you contract it?
sentences.zh: 那么究竟是如何感染的呢？

sentences.en: How does it transmit?
sentences.zh: 它是如何传播的？

sentences.en: It's transmitted mostly by coughing.
sentences.zh: 它主要通过咳嗽传播。

sentences.en: And we think it's transmitted by fomite, which is to say touching surfaces.
sentences.zh: 我们认为它也通过污染物传播，也就是接触表面。

sentences.en: So if you're in this room and you've got it and you've coughed all over this table and I come in later and I don't know you were here and I, you know, I've got my hands on
sentences.zh: 所以如果你在这个房间里而且你感染了，并把咳嗽的飞沫弄满了这张桌子，而我后来进来，我不知道你来过，然后我，你知道的，把手放在

sentences.en: the table and then I pick up my finger and I put it in my eye or my nose, I might get it.
sentences.zh: 桌子上，接着把手指拿起来揉眼睛或摸鼻子，我可能就会被感染。

sentences.en: And that's scary.
sentences.zh: 这太吓人了。

sentences.en: Now there's a cool question of is it got aerosol transmission, which means it drifts through the air and might go through the ventilation system into another room.
sentences.zh: 现在有一个很酷的问题，它是否通过气溶胶传播，这意味着它在空气中漂浮，并可能通过通风系统进入另一个房间。

sentences.en: That might be part of it and there might also be some fecal transmission, but those are unimportant.
sentences.zh: 这可能是其中的一部分，也可能存在一些粪便传播，但这些都不重要。

sentences.en: The main thing is coughing and surfaces.
sentences.zh: 最主要的途径还是咳嗽和接触表面。

sentences.en: That's how it gets transmitted.
sentences.zh: 这就是它的传播方式。

sentences.en: We're still in the early days of knowing about this virus, but that's the prevailing theory that those are the number one and two drivers.
sentences.zh: 我们对这种病毒的了解还处于初期阶段，但目前的普遍理论认为，这两者是第一和第二大驱动因素。

sentences.en: My sense is that when it comes to infections, this is not a virus that discriminates, that young people get it, middle-aged people get it, old people get it.
sentences.zh: 我的感觉是，谈到感染，这种病毒并非因人而异，年轻人会感染，中年人会感染，老年人也会感染。

sentences.en: But do we have a sense of who is most likely to contract this coronavirus?
sentences.zh: 但我们是否知道谁最有可能感染这种冠状病毒？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: It sounds like because it's so transmissible, almost everybody might be able to get it.
sentences.zh: 听起来因为它的传播力极强，几乎所有人都有可能感染。

sentences.en: Oddly enough, children are very unlikely to get this virus.
sentences.zh: 奇怪的是，儿童极不容易感染这种病毒。

sentences.en: Huh, why is that?
sentences.zh: 啊，为什么会这样？

sentences.en: Well, nobody knows.
sentences.zh: 嗯，没有人知道。

sentences.en: The theory I've seen that makes sense is that kids have enormous numbers of these mild coronaviruses because that's the typical cold virus.
sentences.zh: 我见过的最合理的理论是，孩子们体内有大量的这些温和的冠状病毒，因为那是典型的感冒病毒。

sentences.en: Kids are the ones who get colds.
sentences.zh: 孩子们往往是容易感冒的人。

sentences.en: You go to kindergarten, you come back with a cold.
sentences.zh: 你去上幼儿园，回来就带着感冒。

sentences.en: So they may have some immunity from having somewhat similar but mild virus.
sentences.zh: 因此，他们可能因为接触过某种相似但温和的病毒而获得了一定免疫力。

sentences.en: Circulating in the child population, whereas all of us who had those viruses as kids, our immunity of those has waned, and now we have a new coronavirus.
sentences.zh: 这种病毒在儿童群体中传播，而我们所有人在小时候都得过这些病毒，对此类病毒的免疫力已经减弱，现在出现了一种新的冠状病毒。

sentences.en: Our immune system is just not as prepared.
sentences.zh: 我们的免疫系统简直没有做好充分准备。

sentences.en: Yeah, we're susceptible to it.
sentences.zh: 是的，我们很容易受到感染。

sentences.en: The people who are getting sick and hospitalized, basically people from 30 on up.
sentences.zh: 生病和住院的人，基本上是30岁及以上的人群。

sentences.en: Most of the people in the hospitals are between 30 and 79, the Chinese said.
sentences.zh: 中国方面表示，医院里的大多数人年龄在30岁到79岁之间。

sentences.en: Now, the people who die is basically the older you are, the more likely you are to die.
sentences.zh: 至于死亡人员，基本上是年龄越大，死亡的可能性就越高。

sentences.en: So far, the large numbers of deaths have been elderly Chinese men.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，大量的死者都是年长的中国男性。

sentences.en: That's because the virus has been in China, but there's also a phenomenon in China.
sentences.zh: 那是因为病毒一直在中国，但中国还有一个现象。

sentences.en: Something like 50 to 80 percent of all men smoke and only 2 to 3 percent of all women smoke.
sentences.zh: 大约百分之五十到八十的男性吸烟，而女性吸烟率只有百分之二到三。

sentences.en: And once you're a smoker and you're over 50, your lungs are kind of half shot.
sentences.zh: 一旦你开始吸烟，并且年过五十，你的肺基本上就废了一半。

sentences.en: You know, you've got emphysema or COPD, maybe a mild case.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，你患有肺气肿或慢性阻塞性肺病，也许是轻症。

sentences.en: But if you get a dangerous lung infection on top of that, you're much less likely to recover.
sentences.zh: 但如果你在此基础上又感染了危险的肺部疾病，你康复的可能性就会大大降低。

sentences.en: Also, once you're over 65, you have an immune system that starts weakening slowly, so you're less able to bounce back from that kind of thing.
sentences.zh: 此外，一旦你超过六十五岁，免疫系统就会开始慢慢衰退，所以你从这类疾病中恢复过来的能力就会变差。

sentences.en: So we see the death rates are like people in their 80s and then people in their 70s and then people in their 60s.
sentences.zh: 所以我们看到死亡率最高的是八十多岁的人，其次是七十多岁的人，然后是六十多岁的人。

sentences.en: But we've seen people in their 30s die from this.
sentences.zh: 但我们也看到过三十多岁的人死于这种疾病。

sentences.en: We've seen some of the doctors, you know, including the famous doctor Li Wenliang, who tried to raise the alarm.
sentences.zh: 我们看到有一些医生，你知道的，包括试图发出警告的著名医生李文亮。

sentences.en: He was 33 or 34 and he died.
sentences.zh: 他才三十三岁或三十四岁，却去世了。

sentences.en: And how do you explain that?
sentences.zh: 你对此怎么解释？

sentences.en: He might have been unlucky and he might have gotten a big blast of virus from a lot of patients.
sentences.zh: 他可能运气不好，也可能从大量患者那里感染了海量的病毒。

sentences.en: Even with viruses, the dose to some extent makes the poison.
sentences.zh: 即使对于病毒来说，在某种程度上也是剂量决定毒性。

sentences.en: If you get a big load of virus in one blast, your body's overwhelmed more quickly by it.
sentences.zh: 如果你一次性感染了大量的病毒，你的身体就会更快地被其击垮。

sentences.en: And that may have happened to him.
sentences.zh: 他可能就是这种情况。

sentences.en: You've been talking about this death rate of around 2 or 2.5 percent from this coronavirus.
sentences.zh: 你一直在谈论这种冠状病毒大约百分之二到百分之二点五的死亡率。

sentences.en: And you mentioned earlier that that is a lot like the Spanish flu of 1918.
sentences.zh: 你刚才提到这很像一九一八年的西班牙大流感。

sentences.en: For those of us who didn't live in the early 20th century, can you put this into a more modern context?
sentences.zh: 对于我们这些没有在二十世纪初生活过的人来说，你能把它放在一个更现代的背景下来谈谈吗？

sentences.en: How does this compare with the annual flu?
sentences.zh: 这与年度流感相比如何？

sentences.en: How does this compare with something maybe a little more knowable for us?
sentences.zh: 与我们可能稍微熟悉一点的疾病相比，这又如何呢？

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: This is not like the annual flu.
sentences.zh: 这可不是年度流感。

sentences.en: The annual flu in a bad year has a death rate of around 0.1 percent.
sentences.zh: 在糟糕的年份，年度流感的死亡率约为百分之零点一。

sentences.en: So we're talking about 20 times as bad.
sentences.zh: 所以我们谈论的是严重二十倍的疫情。

sentences.en: That's very meaningful.
sentences.zh: 这非常惊人。

sentences.en: When people were going around saying, oh, not to worry about this.
sentences.zh: 当时人们到处说，噢，不用担心这个。

sentences.en: You should get a flu shot because the flu is a bigger threat.
sentences.zh: 你应该去打流感疫苗，因为流感的威胁更大。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: At this moment, the flu is a bigger threat.
sentences.zh: 目前来看，流感的威胁确实更大。

sentences.en: Definitely.
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问。

sentences.en: In the United States.
sentences.zh: 在美国。

sentences.en: But don't think you have nothing to worry about.
sentences.zh: 但别以为你就可以高枕无忧了。

sentences.en: One thing that might happen is it might not get here in a big wave until the fall.
sentences.zh: 有一种可能是，它可能要到秋天才大举蔓延到这里。

sentences.en: That happened in 1918.
sentences.zh: 一九一八年就是这样的。

sentences.en: There was a spring wave that was scary.
sentences.zh: 当时有一个让人心惊肉跳的春季浪潮。

sentences.en: And then the virus mostly disappeared in the summer because a lot of viruses don't like hot weather.
sentences.zh: 然后病毒在夏天基本上消失了，因为很多病毒不喜欢炎热的天气。

sentences.en: But then when it came back on the fall and winter, that was the real killer wave.
sentences.zh: 但当它在秋冬季卷土重来时，那才是真正的杀手级浪潮。

sentences.en: And that's when a lot of people died.
sentences.zh: 正是在那个时候，大量的人失去了生命。

sentences.en: But we conventionally say that if the 1918 flu came back today, it wouldn't be as deadly.
sentences.zh: 但我们通常认为，如果一九一八年的流感在今天卷土重来，它就不会那么致命了。

sentences.en: Because it's not 1918.
sentences.zh: 因为现在不是一九一八年。

sentences.en: Because in 1918, we didn't have antibiotics and a lot of people died of secondary bacterial pneumonias.
sentences.zh: 因为在一九一八年，我们没有抗生素，很多人死于继发性细菌性肺炎。

sentences.en: We didn't have mechanical ventilators to put people on.
sentences.zh: 我们当时没有机械呼吸机来给病人辅助呼吸。

sentences.en: We didn't have the steroids that cuts down on lung inflammation.
sentences.zh: 我们没有能减轻肺部炎症的类固醇药物。

sentences.en: We have a lot of things in modern medical care that we didn't have then.
sentences.zh: 现代医疗护理中有许多我们当时没有的东西。

sentences.en: But what's disturbing about what you see happening in China is that a lot of people are going into hospitals and they are getting antibiotics and they are getting Tamiflu and they are getting antivirals and they are getting steroids and they are getting put on ventilators and they still die.
sentences.zh: 但你在中国看到的情况令人不安的是，很多人去医院接受了抗生素治疗、达菲治疗、抗病毒药物治疗、类固醇治疗，还用上了呼吸机，但他们仍然死亡了。

sentences.en: And that's unexpected.
sentences.zh: 这出乎意料。

sentences.en: And it's quite spooky.
sentences.zh: 而且相当诡异。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用软件？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 已解锁？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to The Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore The Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果你可以免费试用《时报》一个月，且无需输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》应用时，你在该应用中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间可以突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么内容。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to The New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《时报》应用，免费获取三十天的访问权限。

sentences.en: Back now with scientists around the world working day and night to contain the coronavirus.
sentences.zh: 欢迎回来，世界各地的科学家们正在日夜奋战，以遏制冠状病毒。

sentences.en: The Chinese now sharing information with the World Health Organization in the hope that it will lead to treatments for the coronavirus.
sentences.zh: 中国现在正与世界卫生组织分享信息，希望这能带来治疗冠状病毒的方法。

sentences.en: But there has been an effort to secure funding with Congress, some $2.5 billion used for vaccine development, treatment as well as...
sentences.zh: 但各方一直在努力争取国会拨款，大约二十五亿美元用于疫苗开发、治疗以及……

sentences.en: Top health authorities have played down the rising hopes about a vaccine as well as a treatment for the coronavirus.
sentences.zh: 高级卫生官员也淡化了人们对冠状病毒疫苗以及治疗方法的日益增长的期望。

sentences.en: Donald, I want to move into diagnosis and treatment.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德，我想谈谈诊断和治疗。

sentences.en: Right now, correct me if I'm wrong, there is no treatment.
sentences.zh: 目前，如果我没记错的话，还没有治疗方法。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Right now there is no treatment.
sentences.zh: 目前确实没有治疗方法。

sentences.en: I mean, there's treatment in that you hospitalize somebody, you put them on oxygen,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，所谓的治疗是指你让病人住院，给他们吸氧，

sentences.en: and you give them antibiotics so they don't get a secondary bacterial pneumonia or things like that.
sentences.zh: 并给他们使用抗生素，这样他们就不会得继发性细菌性肺炎或类似疾病。

sentences.en: But there's nothing that actually cures this virus.
sentences.zh: 但没有什么东西能真正治愈这种病毒。

sentences.en: Or prevents it.
sentences.zh: 或者预防它。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Nothing that prevents this virus.
sentences.zh: 没有什么能预防这种病毒。

sentences.en: So what are the most promising possibilities out there to do either of those things, and what's the time frame we're looking at to do that?
sentences.zh: 那么，在实现这两者方面，有哪些最有希望的前景？我们期望的时间框架又是怎样的？

sentences.en: There are several antiviral drugs that are being tested.
sentences.zh: 目前正在测试几种抗病毒药物。

sentences.en: Some have been used against HIV.
sentences.zh: 有些曾被用于对抗艾滋病病毒。

sentences.en: Some have been tried against Ebola and didn't work.
sentences.zh: 有些曾被用来对抗埃博拉病毒但没有奏效。

sentences.en: There's an anti-malaria drug they're trying as ways of stopping this.
sentences.zh: 还有一种抗疟疾药物正在试验中，作为阻止这种病毒的方法。

sentences.en: They're doing tests on them in China now, and we may know the results of that trial within the next two or three weeks.
sentences.zh: 他们目前正在中国对这些药物进行测试，我们可能在未来两到三周内知道试验结果。

sentences.en: So far then, none of the experimental treatments for this are known to work.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，还没有哪种针对该病的实验性疗法被证明有效。

sentences.en: They're still in the testing phase.
sentences.zh: 它们仍处于测试阶段。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: Do we know anything?
sentences.zh: 我们知道什么消息吗？

sentences.en: Frankly, I think if there was something that was a miracle drug, it would have leaked right now.
sentences.zh: 坦白说，我认为如果有特效药的话，现在就已经走漏风声了。

sentences.en: Ethically, if it was a miracle, they'd have to stop the trial early and just give everybody that drug.
sentences.zh: 从伦理上讲，如果是特效药，他们就必须提前终止试验，直接把这种药分发给所有人。

sentences.en: Okay, what about a vaccine, something that would prevent this virus?
sentences.zh: 好吧，那疫苗呢，那种能预防这种病毒的东西？

sentences.en: A vaccine is going to take pretty close to a year to produce.
sentences.zh: 生产出疫苗大约需要整整一年的时间。

sentences.en: A year?
sentences.zh: 一年？

sentences.en: A year.
sentences.zh: 一年。

sentences.en: That's a really long time.
sentences.zh: 这真的是一段很长的时间。

sentences.en: Yeah, so we're not, if this virus arrives here, we will not have a vaccine.
sentences.zh: 是的，所以如果这种病毒蔓延到这里，我们将没有疫苗可用。

sentences.en: And the reason is, you have to do the safety and efficacy trials.
sentences.zh: 原因在于，你必须进行安全性和有效性试验。

sentences.en: And those have to be done in animals, and then they have to be done in people.
sentences.zh: 这些试验必须先在动物身上进行，然后才能在人身上进行。

sentences.en: And first you have to do them in a small number of people, and then you do them in a large number of people.
sentences.zh: 而且你必须先在少数人身上进行，接着在大量人群中进行。

sentences.en: Because when you don't do that, you may find, and this has happened, that the vaccine makes the problem worse.
sentences.zh: 因为如果你不这样做，你可能会发现——而且这种情况确实发生过——疫苗反而让问题变得更糟。

sentences.en: What do you mean?
sentences.zh: 你是什么意思？

sentences.en: Well, there have been vaccines that have caused horrible side effects in the paSt.
sentences.zh: 嗯，过去有些疫苗曾引起过可怕的副作用。

sentences.en: And there also have been vaccines that actually make you more susceptible to the disease.
sentences.zh: 而且还出现过实际上让你更容易感染该疾病的疫苗。

sentences.en: There was a dengue vaccine that appeared to make children more susceptible to dengue.
sentences.zh: 曾有一种登革热疫苗似乎让儿童更容易感染登革热。

sentences.en: There was an HIV vaccine trial that had to be stopped because it made people more likely to catch HIV.
sentences.zh: 曾有一项艾滋病病毒疫苗试验不得不叫停，因为它让人更有可能感染艾滋病病毒。

sentences.en: Okay, so during this year when a vaccine would be under development but not yet available, paint a portrait of what is likely to happen.
sentences.zh: 好的，那么在疫苗正在研制但尚未面世的这一年里，请描绘一下可能会发生的情况。

sentences.en: Now, I know, based on my many years as a Times reporter, science and health reporters here do not like to speculate.
sentences.zh: 我懂的，根据我多年担任《时报》记者的经验，这里的科学和健康记者不喜欢进行推测。

sentences.en: But I am going to, with your permission, ask you to speculate a little bit about what that year looks like.
sentences.zh: 但在你的允许下，我要请你对这一年的情况做一点推测。

sentences.en: The worst case scenario and the best case scenario.
sentences.zh: 最坏的情况和最好的情况。

sentences.en: I don't know what's going to happen.
sentences.zh: 我不知道会发生什么。

sentences.en: But keep in mind, the 1918 flu was really the 1918-1919 flu.
sentences.zh: 但请记住，一九一八年的流感实际上是一九一八至一九一九年的流感。

sentences.en: Started in the spring, faded in the summer, came back like a monster in the fall.
sentences.zh: 它在春天爆发，夏天减弱，在秋天像怪物一样卷土重来。

sentences.en: That would be a worst case kind of scenario.
sentences.zh: 那将是最糟糕的一种情况。

sentences.en: That we don't have a vaccine yet by the fall and the disease hits us hard then.
sentences.zh: 也就是到秋天我们还没有疫苗，然后疫情给我们的沉重打击。

sentences.en: In that scenario, could almost every person in the country who's not a child get the virus?
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下，全国几乎所有不是儿童的人都会感染这种病毒吗？

sentences.en: Some big chunk of the country, 30, 40, 50 percent, are likely to get a new virus when it blows through.
sentences.zh: 当新病毒席卷而来时，全国很大一部分人，比如百分之三十、四十、五十的人，很可能会感染。

sentences.en: And if you don't get it in the first wave, you might get it in the second wave.
sentences.zh: 如果你在第一波疫情中没有感染，你可能会在第二波疫情中感染。

sentences.en: And 2 percent lethality rate of 50 percent of the country.
sentences.zh: 如果全国百分之五十的人感染，致死率为百分之二……

sentences.en: I don't want to do that math.
sentences.zh: 我不想去算这笔账。

sentences.en: It's really, really awful.
sentences.zh: 这真的，真的是太可怕了。

sentences.en: It's a lot of people.
sentences.zh: 会有很多人。

sentences.en: It means, you know, you don't die.
sentences.zh: 这意味着，你知道的，你可能不会死。

sentences.en: 80 percent of people have mild cases.
sentences.zh: 百分之八十的人都是轻症。

sentences.en: But you know somebody who dies.
sentences.zh: 但你会认识死去的人。

sentences.en: It's pretty horrible.
sentences.zh: 这相当可怕。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Right now, it's a smaller threat than the flu for us in the United States right now.
sentences.zh: 就目前而言，对我们美国人来说，它的威胁比流感要小。

sentences.en: But it could be a lot worse.
sentences.zh: 但情况可能会变得糟糕得多。

sentences.en: And take that threat seriously.
sentences.zh: 所以要认真对待这种威胁。

sentences.en: And that's what the CDC is saying, too.
sentences.zh: 这也是美国疾病控制与预防中心一直在说的。

sentences.en: Prepare.
sentences.zh: 做好准备。

sentences.en: It's not just prepare as in stock up on food and buy masks.
sentences.zh: 这不仅仅是囤积食物和购买口罩意义上的准备。

sentences.en: It's more like mentally prepare yourself for what would happen if you and all of your friends had to stay home for a month or not be able to ride the subways or supermarkets ran low on food.
sentences.zh: 更像是要在心理上做好准备，如果发生你和所有的朋友都得在家呆上一个月，或者无法乘坐地铁，或者超市食物短缺的情况，你会怎么样。

sentences.en: Or, you know, your medicine, your insulin or your HIV meds or your heart meds or whatever it is you take wasn't available because the supply lines from China have been cut off.
sentences.zh: 或者，你知道的，你的药物、你的胰岛素、你的艾滋病药物、你的心脏病药物或其他你服用的任何东西买不到了，因为来自中国的供应链已经被切断了。

sentences.en: So we got to mentally prepare ourselves for something like that.
sentences.zh: 所以我们必须在心理上为这样事情做好准备。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Now, the best case scenario.
sentences.zh: 现在，我们来看看最好的情况。

sentences.en: The best case scenario is one of these drugs works.
sentences.zh: 最好的情况是其中一种药物起作用了。

sentences.en: And basically, everybody gets sick next year.
sentences.zh: 基本上，明年所有人都会生病。

sentences.en: But everybody who's hospitalized gets a drug that keeps them from dying and keeps them from going into deep, deep, deep respiratory distress.
sentences.zh: 但所有住院的人都能得到一种药物，阻止他们死亡，并防止他们陷入极度严重的呼吸窘迫。

sentences.en: And we have the equivalent of a bad flu season.
sentences.zh: 我们经历的相当于一个糟糕的流感季。

sentences.en: And then everybody says, oh, the media, they blew it out of proportion again.
sentences.zh: 然后每个人都说，哦，是媒体，他们又小题大做了。

sentences.en: You know, it's all ridiculous.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，这太荒谬了。

sentences.en: And, you know, I get blamed.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，我受到了指责。

sentences.en: So too bad.
sentences.zh: 那太糟了。

sentences.en: It's happened before.
sentences.zh: 以前发生过这种情况。

sentences.en: So at this point, American health officials are saying it's just a matter of time.
sentences.zh: 因此，目前美国的卫生官员表示，这只是时间问题。

sentences.en: And they're not saying how much time before this virus reaches the U.S.
sentences.zh: 他们没有说明这种病毒在大规模传入美国并开始传播之前还有多长时间。

sentences.en: in a pretty meaningful way and starts to spread.
sentences.zh: 那么这个国家准备得怎么样了？

sentences.en: So how prepared is this country?
sentences.zh: 准备得还远远不够。

sentences.en: Not prepared enough.
sentences.zh: 而且很难确切知道我们需要做多少准备。

sentences.en: And it's hard to know exactly how prepared we need to be.
sentences.zh: 为什么你说准备不够？

sentences.en: Why do you say not enough?
sentences.zh: 嗯，在任何一个糟糕的流感季，医院都会把所有的呼吸机都给病人用上。

sentences.en: Well, in any bad flu season, hospitals put people on all their ventilators.
sentences.zh: 我们有国家战略储备，里面有很多东西，口罩、手术衣、手套、药物，甚至还有一些呼吸机。

sentences.en: We have a national strategic stockpile, which has a lot of stuff in it, masks, gowns, gloves, drugs, even some ventilators.
sentences.zh: 但你不可能囤积足够的呼吸机来让每个人都用上，因为呼吸机的价格跟汽车差不多。

sentences.en: But you can't stockpile enough ventilators to put people on ventilators like a cost of a car.
sentences.zh: 一台要两万五到五万美元。

sentences.en: It's 25 to 50,000 bucks.
sentences.zh: 医院不可能随随便便出去订购额外的一百台。

sentences.en: Hospitals can't go out and order an extra hundred of those.
sentences.zh: 这绝对是不可能的。

sentences.en: And if they did order an extra hundred of those, it would take a while.
sentences.zh: 如果他们真的多订购了一百台那种设备，那确实需要一段时间。

sentences.en: It would take a while.
sentences.zh: 需要一段时间。

sentences.en: And also, you need at least three people to staff that ventilator with the patient on it around the clock.
sentences.zh: 而且，你还需要至少三个人全天候轮流照看连着呼吸机的病人。

sentences.en: And that's a lot of trained respiratory technicians and things.
sentences.zh: 这就需要大量经过培训的呼吸治疗师之类的人员。

sentences.en: So if we get hit with a gigantic epidemic of a lot of people with pneumonia needing to be on breathing machines, we're not prepared for that.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果我们遭遇大规模的肺炎疫情爆发，有大量患者需要使用呼吸机，我们是做不到这一点的。

sentences.en: What about preparations beyond ventilators?
sentences.zh: 那么在呼吸机之外还有哪些准备呢？

sentences.en: What happened in China with the shutdown of Wuhan and Hubei province during Tet, during New Year,
sentences.zh: 中国在春节期间对武汉和湖北省实施封城，

sentences.en: was the equivalent of shutting down Chicago and most of that surrounding part of the Midwest at Christmastime.
sentences.zh: 这就相当于在圣诞节期间关闭芝加哥以及中西部大部分周边地区。

sentences.en: And telling people, you are now going to stay in Chicago, you can't leave, you can't see your families, all the flights are canceled, all the trains are canceled,
sentences.zh: 并告诉人们，你们现在得留在芝加哥，不能离开，不能见家人，所有航班取消，所有火车取消，

sentences.en: all the highways are closed, you're going to stay in there.
sentences.zh: 所有高速公路封闭，你们必须待在里面。

sentences.en: And you're locked in with a deadly disease.
sentences.zh: 而且你们被锁在一种致命的疾病当中。

sentences.en: We can do it.
sentences.zh: 我们能做到这一点。

sentences.en: Would we do that?
sentences.zh: 我们会这样做吗？

sentences.en: We can do it.
sentences.zh: 我们能做到。

sentences.en: But we're not used to being controlled from the top down the way people have been in China.
sentences.zh: 但我们不习惯像中国那样自上而下受到管控。

sentences.en: So I don't know what's going to happen in the United States.
sentences.zh: 所以我不知道美国会发生什么。

sentences.en: We're not mentally prepared to fight a sort of people's war against an epidemic, which is what happened in China.
sentences.zh: 我们从心理上还没有准备好去打一场类似中国那种针对疫情的人民战争。

sentences.en: Before I let you go, I feel like I have to ask you, given your experience covering these kinds of epidemics, what kind of preparations are you personally making?
sentences.zh: 在我让你离开之前，我觉得我不得不问你，鉴于你报道这类疫情的经验，你个人正在做哪些准备？

sentences.en: I have food in the basement anyway.
sentences.zh: 我的地下室里本来就备有食物。

sentences.en: I always have about a month's worth of food in the basement because that's the kind of person I am.
sentences.zh: 我地下室里总是备着大概一个月的食物，因为我就是这样的人。

sentences.en: I'll probably order some more of my heart, you know, blood pressure medicine, you know, so that I have another 90 days supply.
sentences.zh: 我可能会再订购一些我的心脏病药，你知道的，还有降压药，这样我就能有备用90天的量。

sentences.en: I shouldn't stockpile masks.
sentences.zh: 我不应该囤积口罩。

sentences.en: I'm against it.
sentences.zh: 我反对这样做。

sentences.en: I did go out and buy a box of 10 masks back in January.
sentences.zh: 我在一月份确实出去买了一盒10个装的口罩。

sentences.en: I feel a little ashamed I did that because really those masks are more important on health care workers than they are on me.
sentences.zh: 我为此感到有点羞愧，因为说实话，对医护人员来说，这些口罩比对我更重要。

sentences.en: Otherwise, I'm not sure there's much you can do.
sentences.zh: 除此之外，我不确定你还能做什么。

sentences.en: You know, I take some comfort in the fact that 80 percent of the people have a mild disease, and that might be me and everybody I love, too.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，让我感到一丝安慰的是，80%的人感染的都是轻症，我和我爱的人可能也是如此。

sentences.en: We might all get lucky, but not everybody we know is going to get lucky if this turns into something like 1918.
sentences.zh: 我们可能都会走运，但如果这演变成像1918年那样的大流行，我们认识的人就不会个个都那么走运了。

sentences.en: Well, thank you, Donald.
sentences.zh: 好的，谢谢你，唐纳德。

sentences.en: You're welcome.
sentences.zh: 不客气。

sentences.en: On Wednesday, U.S.
sentences.zh: 周三，美国

sentences.en: health officials reported the first American infected with the coronavirus who had not traveled to countries in which the disease was circulating.
sentences.zh: 卫生官员报告了首例感染冠状病毒的美国人，此人并未去过该病毒正在传播的国家。

sentences.en: Such an infection may represent a case of community transmission, which would be a turning point for the virus in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 这种感染可能代表着社区传播的病例，这将是该病毒在美国的一个转折点。

sentences.en: I've just received another briefing from a great group of talented people on the virus that is going around to various parts of the world.
sentences.zh: 我刚刚听取了一群优秀且才华横溢的人士就世界各地正在蔓延的病毒所做的又一次简报。

sentences.en: On Wednesday night, President Trump addressed the nation about the virus from the White House,
sentences.zh: 周三晚间，特朗普总统在白宫就疫情向全国发表了讲话，

sentences.en: heralding his administration's handling of the situation so far, describing the risk to Americans as low,
sentences.zh: 他称赞了本届政府迄今为止对局势的处理，将美国民众面临的风险描述为低风险，

sentences.en: and appointing his vice president, Mike Pence, to oversee the response effort.
sentences.zh: 并任命副总统迈克·彭斯负责监督应对工作。

sentences.en: We're ready to adapt, and we're ready to do whatever we have to as the disease spreads, if it spreads.
sentences.zh: 我们随时准备适应，也准备好随着疫情蔓延（如果蔓延的话）采取任何必须的措施。

sentences.en: Asked whether the U.S.
sentences.zh: 当被问及美国

sentences.en: would undertake the kind of sweeping measures used to contain the virus in China, the president said that nothing was off the table.
sentences.zh: 是否会采取像中国那样全面遏制病毒的举措时，总统表示一切皆有可能。

sentences.en: Mr. President, have you presented any plans that would involve quarantining cities like we saw in China, and what would have to happen for you to take a step on that?
sentences.zh: 总统先生，您是否提出过任何涉及像我们在中国看到的那样对城市进行隔离的计划，您需要发生什么才会采取这一步措施？

sentences.en: We do have plans on a much larger scale, should we need that.
sentences.zh: 如果我们需要的话，我们确实有规模大得多的计划。

sentences.en: We're working with states.
sentences.zh: 我们正在与各州合作。

sentences.en: We're working with virtually every state.
sentences.zh: 我们实际上正在与几乎每一个州合作。

sentences.en: And we do have plans on a larger scale if we need it.
sentences.zh: 如果需要的话，我们确实有更大规模的计划。

sentences.en: We don't think we're going to need it, but, you know, you always have to be prepared.
sentences.zh: 我们认为我们不需要它，但是，你知道，你总是必须做好准备。

sentences.en: As of Wednesday, more new cases of infection were reported outside of China than inside of it.
sentences.zh: 截至周三，在中国境外报告的新增感染病例数超过了中国境内。

sentences.en: The total number of cases has now surpassed 80,000, and nearly 3,000 have died.
sentences.zh: 病例总数现已超过8万例，近3000人死亡。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他内容。

sentences.en: At least 25 people have died in some of India's worst Hindu-Muslim violence in years.
sentences.zh: 印度近年来最严重的印度教与穆斯林暴力冲突中，至少已有25人死亡。

sentences.en: The violence began with a speech from a local Hindu official calling for the forceful removal of Muslims who were protesting India's new citizenship law,
sentences.zh: 暴力事件始于一名当地印度教官员的演讲，他呼吁强行驱逐抗议印度新公民法的穆斯林，

sentences.en: which is widely seen as discriminating against MusliMs.
sentences.zh: 该法律被广泛认为是对穆斯林的歧视。

sentences.en: Within hours of that speech, violence had broken out, much of it directed at Muslims,
sentences.zh: 演讲后数小时内，暴力冲突便已爆发，其中大部分针对穆斯林，

sentences.en: the latest case of what many inside and outside of India see as the rising danger of Hindu nationalism.
sentences.zh: 这是印度国内外的许多人视为印度教民族主义危险日益加剧的又一例证。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Bavaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴瓦罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》中，我们正在为假期招待客人做准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让客人们宾至如归的小贴士。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是那种对光线极度敏感、需要全黑环境才能入睡的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们会不会喝到断片来睡觉。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们需要什么样的光线条件？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物禁忌吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们习惯喝咖啡还是茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 在纽约时报应用程序或您喜欢收听播客的任何地方搜索《Wirecutter秀》。
